landing.heroTitle: Predict every match, challenge friends, and follow the World Cup like a pro.
landing.heroSubtitle: Build your own tournament story with score predictions, venue information, AI-flavoured expert analysis, private subleagues, and chat for your group.
landing.previewExpertText: Compare your instinct with an expert score suggestion before you lock in your prediction.

venues.title: Venue information
venues.text: Explore stadiums, cities, expected conditions, transport tips, and match schedules.

analysis.title: Expert analysis
analysis.text: Read colourful AI-style commentary for fixtures before making your pick.

helper.title: Prediction helper
helper.text: Use ranking-based score suggestions as a second opinion for every match.

subleague.title: Private subleagues
subleague.text: Create a mini-league for friends, family, or colleagues and track your own leaderboard.

chat.title: Subleague chat
chat.text: Talk trash, celebrate exact scores, and keep the competition alive inside your group.

landing.expertsText: A playful cast of AI-inspired pundits brings personality to match previews. Their avatars are original capsule-cartoon versions made for this game.
landing.finalText: Register, make your first predictions, invite your subleague, and enjoy World Cup 2026 together.

adminScores.title: Official scores (plan B)
adminScores.intro: If automatic updates fail, enter the real result here and apply. The site stores these as the official scores and recalculates every player’s points from them (for matches marked completed).
adminScores.savedRecalc: Saved. Points have been recalculated from all completed matches.
adminScores.footerHint: Mark a match as completed when the result is final so it counts in the rankings. In progress is for a live game; upcoming resets the fixture on the public schedule (use carefully).

adminSubgroups.title: Admin · Subgroups
adminSubgroups.intro: All subgroups site-wide. You can delete only subgroups that have no members (e.g. orphaned rows).
adminSubgroups.deleteOnlyWhenEmpty: Remove all members first, or use the subgroup admin delete flow.

adminSettings.title: Admin · Settings
adminSettings.intro: All registered accounts. Promote or demote admins (at least one admin must remain). Set a new sign-in password for any user in the browser—nothing is sent by email. Deleting a user removes their predictions from the pool.
adminSettings.confirmDelete: Permanently delete user "{{username}}"? This cannot be undone.
adminSettings.cannotDemoteLastAdmin: There must be at least one administrator.
adminSettings.resetPasswordHint: The new password applies immediately. No email is sent—tell the user the password out of band if they need it.
adminSettings.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
adminSettings.selfPasswordNote: If this is you, use the new password the next time you sign in.

login.title: Worldcup 2026 game
login.subtitle: Sign in to make your World Cup predictions

forgotPassword.title: Reset password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your username and the email on your account. If they match, you can set a new password (no email is sent).
forgotPassword.success: Your password was updated. You can sign in now.

register.title: Join Worldcup 2026 game
register.subtitle: Create your account and start predicting

dashboard.notInAnySubgroup: You are not in a subgroup yet. Create one or accept an invite under Subgroup.
dashboard.noUnreadSubgroup: No unread messages in your subgroups.

matches.title: Match Schedule
matches.virtualHint: Derived from your predicted scores for this group. Predictions for group games you have not filled yet are omitted from the totals.
matches.virtualLegendYellow: Row 3 (yellow): among the top 8 third-placed teams
matches.virtualLegendYellowRed: Row 3 (red): third place but not among best thirds
matches.selectGroupForVirtual: Tip: choose a specific group (A–L) in the filter above to see your predicted group table here. On a group match page, the table appears automatically.

matchDetail.savedAllComplete: Prediction saved — you’re all caught up on upcoming matches.
matchDetail.locked: Predictions are locked for this match.
matchDetail.predictionReadOnly: This match is live or the result is final — your tip is read-only below. If the match is set back to upcoming, you can edit it again.
matchDetail.lockedBeforeKickoff: Predictions are locked — the match starts in less than 4 hours.
matchDetail.noPredictionBeforeLock: You did not save a tip before the cutoff.
matchDetail.noPredictions: No predictions yet for this match.
matchDetail.predictionProgressTip: There are many matches — you don't need to predict them all at once. Enter only the tips you want; next time you can pick up where you left off.
matchDetail.predictionTipAcknowledge: Got it, don't show this again
matchDetail.scoresRequired: Enter both home and away scores before saving.

subgroups.title: Subgroup
subgroups.intro: Create a private mini-league with friends or colleagues. You can only join when invited by email (in-app notification here; optional email if the server has SMTP configured).
subgroups.noneYet: You are not in any subgroup yet. Create one or accept an invitation.
subgroups.notFound: Subgroup not found or you are not a member.
subgroups.confirmLeave: Leave this subgroup? You can rejoin only if invited again.
subgroups.confirmDeleteSubgroup: Delete this subgroup for everyone? All members, chat, and invites will be removed. This cannot be undone.
subgroups.inviteHelp: The person must register with this exact email. They will see the invite under Subgroup.
subgroups.chatMaxNote: The chat keeps the 256 most recent messages; older ones are removed when new ones arrive.
subgroups.unreadChatBadge: {{count}} unread message(s) in this subgroup chat
subgroups.confirmRemoveMember: Remove {{username}} from this subgroup? They can rejoin only if invited again.

groups.title: Group Standings
groups.subtitle: Official tables from real matches that have been played (results entered in this pool). These are not your personal predicted standings — your virtual group tables appear on the Matches page when you choose a group.

rankings.title: Participant Rankings
rankings.noRankings: No rankings yet. Start making predictions!
rankings.cumulativeNote: Points are cumulative. A perfect prediction earns 3 + 8 + 1 = 12 points.
